result: INCOMPLETE: blocked on a ruling. liella_ld::start::bias has landed on origin/next 7d31b0621, but this branch is based on f1f5358d5 without it, and the brief allows no merge. No code changed.

rulings.item: The branch must merge origin/next to reach liella_ld::start::bias (landed with DL-IMAGE-READER-3). thread_common forbids a merge that the brief does not allow, and a re-cut needs a force-push.
rulings.recommendation: Allow `git merge --no-edit origin/next` into task/dl-libc-start-bias (a fast-forward push; the branch holds only this story's handoff commits), or re-create the branch from origin/next before the next run.

informational: Baseline cbench_startup from run 1 (origin/next f1f5358d5, keke): startup_instr_c 2146, startup_instr_setloc 68079, startup_instr_printf 71876, startup_instr_wctype 69106. Take a new baseline on the merged base.

Design point: the shared bias function is in liella_ld, but libc's start (liella_boundary) uses liella_rt::start. One implementation probably means moving it to liella_rt::start and having liella_ld call or re-export it.
improvement: When a blocked story is re-admitted after its prerequisite lands, the dispatcher should re-cut the branch from origin/next (or the brief should allow the merge). Without that, run 2 hits the same wall.
next_step: After the ruling: merge origin/next, share bias via liella_rt::start, add the no-PT_PHDR PIE/ET_EXEC tests, plant, and compare cbench_startup.
